subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Compliance Process Breakdowns
description: A micro-lesson that makes Compliance Process Breakdowns usable.

hook.text: A bank misses a regulatory filing deadline. The fine is $50 million. The task took one person ten minutes.

buildup.text: Compliance processes require timely filings, accurate reports, and consistent monitoring — all prone to human error.

discovery.text: Wells Fargo's fake accounts scandal started as a sales process failure that compliance didn't catch for years.

twist.text: Process failures in compliance compound. One missed check enables the next, creating an invisible debt of risk.

climax.text: Compliance isn't a one-time check. It's an ongoing process that fails silently until the consequences arrive.

punchline.text: One missed filing. $50 million fine. Process matters.

quiz.question: What was the root cause of the Wells Fargo fake accounts scandal?
options: A sales process failure that compliance didn't catch
